en_how: A CPU stable-fluids solver (advection, pressure projection, vorticity confinement) is re-run from time 0 for every frame, so each frame depends only on t; four Lissajous emitters inject orange, red, magenta and cyan dye and push extra bursts on the beat; the dye field is upscaled, mapped through 1 - exp for glowing colour, blurred into an additive bloom layer, and overlaid with a small parameter panel.
